text:
maria: Quick sync for Catalyst Node EAP — primary goals: NDA, telemetry schema, bench reproducibility, and shipping schedule.
kevin: Legal update: requested one small clause tweak around liability cap. Catalyst GC approved our counter-proposal this morning.
catalyst-eng: confirmed. signed copy will be uploaded to the shared drive by EOD and link posted here.
anika: telemetry ask from our side: minimally include timestamp, model_id, sequence_length, tokens_generated, p50/p95 latency, gpu_util_pct, batch_size, power_draw_w, and an anonymized request_id. prefer Prometheus metrics + periodic JSON dumps.
catalyst-eng: test firmware exposes a Prometheus endpoint (port 9100). we can enable it for lab machines. happy to provide a sample scrape config.
samir: benchmark targets to validate in EAP: p50 < 35ms for 2048 tokens on redwood-13b-int4, sustained throughput >= 30 seq/s at batch=8. aim for within 20% of our internal baselines for the EAP release.
maria: can we standardize a perf harness command so teams can reproduce locally? example:
```
./bench.sh --host 10.11.2.7 --model redwood-13b --precision int4 --batch 8 --length 2048 --iters 20
```
kevin: add to that harness a simple log uploader that sanitizes request payloads per NDA. legal insisted on no raw prompt dumps.
anika: will draft a JSON schema for telemetry and anonymization rules. will open PR in catalyst-eap repo by tomorrow noon.
catalyst-eng: shipping: we can ship 6 dev kits next Monday, ETA to our lab Wed 09:00 PST. packing list will include SFPs and power supply details.
samir: please include per-slot power measurement connectors; we need continuous thermal telemetry during soak tests.
maria: announce cadence proposal: 2-week soak -> perf recap -> decide on joint blog. marketing will prepare a draft but no publish until both sides OK. legal wants a 2-week embargo after mutual approval.
catalyst-eng: fine with embargo. we prefer announcement only if benchmarks reproduce and telemetry pipeline works end-to-end. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar invite: Catalyst EAP sync — Wed 09:30 PST. Invite sent to listed participants.
maria: actions: (1) kevin post signed NDA link, (2) anika PR telemetry schema, (3) samir commit harness + targets, (4) catalyst-eng ship kits and enable prometheus. I will track go/no-go cadence.
kevin: uploaded signed NDA: https://drive.redwood.ai/signed/catalyst-nda.pdf
anika: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/catalyst-eap/pulls/14 — telemetry-schema.json
samir: perf harness added to repo: run_in_lab.sh and README with expected flags.
maria: thanks all. keeping this thread as single source of truth for EAP logistics. ping if anything blocks. :rocket:
